CustomField.description: Determines where the formTemplate runtime places the navigation button bar: Docked (default sticky bar), Footer (rendered into the footer region), or Standard (inline at the end of page content).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Choose where the Previous/Next/Finish buttons sit: Docked (sticky to the viewport), Footer (inside the form footer), or Standard (inline below the page). Docked is the default.
CustomField.label: Button(s) Position
